title: What if all of Earth's ice melted? 🌊
subject: ice
description:
Would your town still be above water? 👇

What would happen if every glacier and ice sheet on Earth melted? Sea level would rise by more than 200 feet, Florida and the US East Coast would vanish, and new inland seas would form. Scientists estimate melting it all would take more than 5,000 years.

Sources: USGS ("How would sea level change if all glaciers melted?"), National Geographic ("What the World Would Look Like if All the Ice Melted"), Scientific American

scenes.text: Florida would disappear under the sea.
Melt every glacier and ice sheet on Earth, and the oceans rise more than 200 feet.
The whole US East Coast and the Gulf Coast go under. London and Venice, gone.
In China, land that's home to 600 million people floods.
But here's the strange part. It wouldn't happen overnight. Scientists estimate it would take more than 5,000 years.
